items.title: Nick Smith Jr. spent most of last season on a two-way contract with the Los Angeles Lakers before being promoted ahead of Kobe Bufkin to a standard contract in time for the postseason
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Nick Smith Jr. spent most of last season on a two-way contract with the Los Angeles Lakers before being promoted ahead of Kobe Bufkin to a standard contract in time for the postseason

This season, Smith will begin with Real Madrid
